guards: All Matthew and Luke textual parent lines are separate; no data-merge into one biological tree.
Jesus: Joseph is legal/putative father; never infer his biological fatherhood or introduce siblings as Mary's biological children.
Acts 8 Philip the Evangelist is not Philip the Apostle.
Revelation's John cannot silently be identified with the son of Zebedee; separate authorship attribution.
Travel paths connect narrated scriptural stops only in narrative order; they are schematic straight lines, not ancient roads.
Patristic and later mission regions are association markers, never assumed travelled segments.
Undocumented Apostles stay discoverable as hold dossiers, with zero fabricated pins.
Place coordinates are approximate editorial map anchors; physical/geographical certification not complete.
Named women in Matthew 1 are displayed as scriptural associations, not reclassified as the links of a paternal sequence.
The David-to-Jesus trajectories of Matthew and Luke have independent positions; no generational equivalence is inferred from visual alignment.
A broad-region location outside the current validated coastline map extent remains a textual evidence entry, not an off-map pin.
For any held apostolic itinerary the cited passage must actually name the person.
Cain's Enoch and the Enoch of Jared, plus both Lamechs, have independent IDs; homonymous persons are not silently merged.
Genesis maternal identifiers are displayed as source-supplied annotations and not inserted into Matthew or Luke.
Only Scripture-linked reviewed family edges appear in the cinematic tree; the 3,231-person index remains a separate research catalogue.
